full_judgment: 37. PW 23 Md Kamrul Islam, police inspector, CMP investigated the case who visited the place of occurrence, prepared sketch map with index Exhibit 10 and recorded the statement of the witness under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. He has also sent part of the firearm to the ballistic expert and collected opinion Exhibit 7 and ultimately submitted report with a recommendation to stand trial of the 13 accused-persons including the convicted accused for committing the offence punishable under sections 120(B)/302/34 of the Penal Code. During cross-examination, he has also admitted that PW 1 did not mention the names of the accuseds Maruf Sikder and Nawab Ali at the time of investigation.
